background: Family Building Society is the trading name of National Counties Building Society, a small mutual based in Epsom, funded by retail savings and lending on residential, later-life and family-assisted mortgages.
synthesis: None of the three agencies rates the society. Capital is strong against UK building societies: CET1 of 17.8% and leverage of 6.1% both sit at the medians, so the society is a typical peer on capital. Liquidity is mixed, with LCR of 235% in the top quarter against the peer median but NSFR of 145% at the median. Since 31 Dec 2022 CET1 has fallen 2.9 points and NSFR 5 points, while LCR has risen 45 points, so the society has shifted toward liquidity and away from capital headroom. The figures run to 31 Dec 2025. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
